integrity: The proof supplies a symbolic all-size integral unimodular congruence. Finite tests independently reconstruct examples using the Python standard library. No independent mathematical review or certification is asserted.
limitations: Applies to pairwise unit-distance realizability over an individually named distance-four equilateral base in the countable integral Urysohn space of diameter four. Not a result for arbitrary bases or simultaneous multitype realizations. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Integral splitting of unit-distance type compatibility in the diameter-four Urysohn space
